# Classifier corpus: one statement (one Query message) per record.
# Format: <flags><TAB><text>. Text that starts with a double quote is a Go quoted string.
# Flags: R:<reason> (rejected) or F (forwarded); ro (read-only-provable); co (coalescable);
# tx:<none|begins|ends|within|unknown>; opaque; hint; bad (the lexer cannot tokenise it);
# noexec (tier R does not run it; the reason is in NOTES.md). Flags not named are false.
